legacy_failure_addressed: Legacy bot operated without a typed, deterministic, offline-inspectable decision-explainability data contract. Per the legacy audits and the prior 2N / 2O / 2P / 2Q evidence-collection harnesses, decision-explainability evidence was scattered across legacy logs, ad-hoc monitor scripts, and the legacy account-history record set, with no parallel typed projection that lifts a typed RiskDecisionRecord into a single typed envelope row carrying mirrored lineage IDs (feature_snapshot_id, prediction_id, decision_id, risk_decision_id), mirrored orchestrator-side and risk-side action / reason codes, mirrored decision timestamp, mirrored harness-level PaperModeFlag state, and deterministic test-only metadata (source_scenario_slug, step_index, legacy_evidence_pointer). Phase 2R records this decision-explainability-projection gap as the first Lane B post-consolidation typed-mirror evidence-collection artifact: a deterministic four-scenario typed evidence pack (12 typed input rows) and a pure-function projection harness driving the existing PaperModeRuntime composition root once at harness level. Phase 2R does NOT introduce an explainability-rendering FastAPI route, an explainability frontend page, an explainability scheduler, an explainability background loop, an explainability persistence layer, an explainability Redis adapter, or any Binance read-only API client. Phase 2R produces typed decision-explainability envelope rows that subsequent Lane B UI panel milestones consume as real backend contracts (per REQ_0009 § Required UI visibility and REQ_0018 lane B, no fake reasoning, real lineage IDs only). The richer explainability fields (top positive / negative feature contributors, feature-freshness flags, regime context, model / checkpoint version, confidence delta, calibration, position sizing reason, risk-check ledger, blocked-trade reason, paper / shadow / legacy comparison, full audit timeline) belong to separate, later milestones explicitly out of scope at Phase 2R; their underlying lineage / projection subsystems do not exist at consolidation HEAD. The LAB hedge-unwind / squeeze loser-trade evidence is included at Phase 2R only as a deterministic typed pointer literal carried on the per-row envelope's legacy_evidence_pointer field for the decision_explainability_pack_lab_loser_short scenario steps; Phase 2R does NOT introduce a hedge / residual-exposure / squeeze-risk model.
mvp_relevance: First Lane B post-consolidation explainability UI milestone backed strictly by real lineage IDs (feature_snapshot_id, prediction_id, decision_id, risk_decision_id) and existing typed surface fields (RiskDecisionRecord input_decision_action / input_decision_reason_code / risk_action / risk_reason_code / live_blocked / risk_decision_ts_ms / symbol; harness-level PaperModeFlag mode / live_blocked). Authors a deterministic four-scenario typed evidence pack (decision_explainability_pack_btc_winner_long x3, decision_explainability_pack_eth_winner_short x3, decision_explainability_pack_lab_loser_short x3 [LAB hedge-unwind / squeeze legacy-failure pointer], decision_explainability_pack_sol_orchestrator_held x3; total 12 typed DecisionExplainabilityFixtureInput rows) and a pure-function projection harness driving the existing PaperModeRuntime composition root once at harness level (no per-row composition-root invocation; no PaperExecutionLedgerRecorder invocation; no RiskDecisionEvaluator invocation; no OrchestratorDecisionRouter invocation; no ReplayBacktestRunner invocation). The harness produces 12 typed DecisionExplainabilityEnvelope rows (one per typed input row) carrying only fields derived from the source RiskDecisionRecord, the harness-level PaperModeFlag, and deterministic test-only metadata (source_scenario_slug, step_index, legacy_evidence_pointer). Establishes the typed offline-inspectable backend contract that subsequent Lane B UI panel milestones (Mission Control, Signal Explainability, Risk Gateway, Audit Ledger per REQ_0009 § Website pages) consume per REQ_0009 § Required UI visibility and REQ_0018 lane B (no fake reasoning, real lineage IDs only). Does not enable live trading. Does not introduce a shadow_decision_id, execution_intent_id, or new standalone paper_trade_id lineage row beyond the existing PaperExecutionLedgerEntry composition-root carried field. Does not introduce confidence-attribution, top-positive / top-negative feature contributors, feature-freshness flags, regime context, calibration, model-version, position-sizing-reason, risk-check-list, blocked-trade-reason, paper-shadow-legacy-comparison, or audit-timeline fields. Does not introduce hedge / residual-exposure / squeeze-risk modelling. Does not introduce PnL / size / price / fees / slippage / funding / OI / liquidation / orderbook computation. Does not modify any file under v2/backend/app/. Does not modify any file under v2/frontend/. Does not call any Binance read-only account-history endpoint at this stage; the live Binance read-only pull described in REQ_0024 remains a separate, later milestone explicitly out of scope at Phase 2R. Does not flip the live-readiness gate.
